description: Standard ground dry mix. Easy to prepare but higher selective sorting and feeder waste.
Heat/steam compaction gelatinizes starches, improving energy utilization and eliminating feed sorting.
24-48 hour water soak activates phytase enzymes, unlocking bound phosphorus and adding probiotic gut support.
Converts starches into simple sugars and vitamins (A, E, B-complex). Higher moisture content drops dry-matter energy density.
Stimulates gizzard muscle development and slower gut motility, but strictly requires insoluble granite grit for grinding.
